# AI News Maker (https://www.ainewsmaker.online)
# Extended LLMs Context & Technical Documentation File
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org/

## Organization & Platform Overview
AI News Maker (Breaking News Wala) is a next-generation cloud-hosted journalistic media platform founded to streamline verified Hindi news reporting, visual storytelling, and multi-format broadcasting.

- **Publisher Organization**: Breaking News Wala / AI News Maker
- **Production Website**: https://www.ainewsmaker.online
- **Secondary Host**: https://ainewsmaker.online
- **Geographic Focus**: Madhya Pradesh (Central India) and National (India)
- **Primary Language**: Hindi (हिन्दी, Devnagari script)
- **Primary CMS & Backend**: Cloud-hosted Express & Firestore App Hosting with server-side Open Graph and SEO prerendering.
- **Support Email**: breakingnewswala.com@gmail.com
- **Helpline**: +91-9669802408

## Editorial Workflow & News Production
1. **Source Ingestion & Verification**: Regional ground reporters, verified government press releases (DPR MP), and trusted news wire RSS sources are aggregated in real time.
2. **Editorial Approval Desk**: Senior editors review headlines, fact-check details, and approve news items to prevent misinformation.
3. **Multi-Format Output**:
   - **Photo News Cards**: Standard 4:5 social posts and 9:16 vertical stories with customized Hindi typography, district badges, reporter branding, and breaking news banners.
   - **Video News Reels**: 9:16 vertical short-form reels with animated captions, background audio, and lower-third graphics.
   - **Live Newsroom Feed**: Instant web-accessible articles indexed for web search and syndication.
   - **Syndication**: Auto-generated RSS 2.0 (`/rss.xml`), Google News Sitemap (`/sitemap-news.xml`), and standard XML Sitemap (`/sitemap.xml`).

## Content Beats & Topical Taxonomy
- **Madhya Pradesh State News (मध्यप्रदेश)**:
  - Bhopal (राजधानी भोपाल)
  - Indore (व्यापारिक राजधानी इंदौर)
  - Gwalior (चंबल-ग्वालियर)
  - Jabalpur (महाकोशल जबलपुर)
  - Ujjain (मालवा-उज्जैन)
  - Chhindwara, Rewa, Sagar, Satna, Ratlam, Khandwa, Khargone, Shivpuri, Bhind, Morena, and all 55 districts.
- **Government Schemes & Governance (योजनाएं व नीतियां)**:
  - CM Ladli Behna Yojana (मुख्यमंत्री लाड़ली बहना योजना)
  - Kisan Kalyan Yojana (किसान कल्याण योजना)
  - Sambal 2.0 (संबल योजना)
  - Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना)
  - State Cabinet Decisions and Legislative Ordinances.
- **National Affairs (देश व राजनीति)**:
  - Parliament proceedings, national politics, state elections, Supreme Court verdicts, and foreign relations.
- **Agriculture & Commodity Markets (कृषि एवं मंडी भाव)**:
  - Daily APMC mandi rates (सोयाबीन, गेहूं, चना, मक्का), weather forecasts, and farmer advisories.
- **Technology & Innovation (तकनीक व विज्ञान)**:
  - ISRO space missions, digital governance, AI developments, and cyber safety.
